title: FDA rebukes 2 Indian API plants over data controls, sanitation issues
llm_note: The FDA issued warning letters to two Indian API manufacturing plants for sanitation and data control failures.

title: Repligen’s $1.5B buy for BioLife; BeOne’s $300M US expansion
llm_note: Repligen is acquiring cell processing supplier BioLife Solutions for $1.5 billion.

title: BeOne jumps aboard onshoring train with $300M to add small molecule production in US
llm_note: BeOne Medicines is investing $300 million to expand its small molecule manufacturing campus in New Jersey.
